d:
Hal hi men katar, turki, pakistan aur indoneshiya ne barhti kshetriy suraksha chintaon ke bich doha men badr samjhauta ko lekar sahamti banaee hai. is badr samjhaute ka matlab kya hai aur ye makka samjhaute se kitna alag hai? sath hi bharat ko kya isse chinta karne ki zarurat hai?
Chalie aapko yahi samjhane ki koshish karte hain.
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
BBC News hindi ko chunen aur paie nyuz alart, laiv tivi, podkast... sab ek jagah.
(kripya not karen: naya aip briten aur amerika men uplabdh nahin hai.)
